/*
	Báo cáo hợp đồng (yêu cầu xuất)
	Nguồn hợp đồng: SMS_OutputOrder + SMS_OutputOrderDetail + SMS_Item
	Giá trị hợp đồng: Sum(SMS_OutputOrderDetail.Money)
	Giá trị đã thực hiện: Sum(SMS_OutputVoucherDetail.Money) từ phiếu xuất trộn/cân (OutputTypeID = 11)
	Ngày lọc: SMS_OutputOrder.OutputOrderDate
	Chi nhánh: CRM_Partner.OfficeID
*/
ALTER PROC [dbo].[SMS_OutputOrder_BaoCaoHopDong]
(
	@OfficeID int = null,
	@FromDate DATETIME,
	@ToDate DATETIME = null
)
As
BEGIN

	If @ToDate is null set @ToDate = GETDATE()
	set @ToDate = @ToDate + 1

	----------- Danh sách hợp đồng trong khoảng thời gian ---------------
	Select tblOrder.OutputOrderID,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderCode,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderNo,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderDate,
		tblOrder.PartnerID
	Into #tblOrder
	From SMS_OutputOrder tblOrder
		Inner join CRM_Partner on CRM_Partner.PartnerID = tblOrder.PartnerID
	Where tblOrder.IsDeleted = 0
		and tblOrder.IsCanceled = 0
		and tblOrder.PartnerID is not null
		and CRM_Partner.IsDeleted = 0
		and (@OfficeID is null or CRM_Partner.OfficeID = @OfficeID)
		and tblOrder.OutputOrderDate >= @FromDate
		and tblOrder.OutputOrderDate < @ToDate

	----------- Giá trị hợp đồng theo mã yêu cầu ---------------
	Select tblDetail.OutputOrderID,
		Sum(isnull(tblDetail.Money, 0)) as GiaTriHopDong
	Into #tblGiaTriHopDong
	From #tblOrder
		Inner join SMS_OutputOrderDetail tblDetail on tblDetail.OutputOrderID = #tblOrder.OutputOrderID
	Group by tblDetail.OutputOrderID

	----------- Giá trị đã thực hiện (phiếu xuất trộn/cân - OutputTypeID = 11) ---------------
	Select tblOutput.OutputOrderID,
		Sum(isnull(tblDetail.Money, 0)) as GiaTriDaThucHien
	Into #tblGiaTriDaThucHien
	From #tblOrder
		Inner join SMS_OutputVoucher tblOutput on tblOutput.OutputOrderID = #tblOrder.OutputOrderID
		Inner join SMS_OutputVoucherDetail tblDetail on tblDetail.OutputVoucherID = tblOutput.OutputVoucherID
	Where tblOutput.IsDeleted = 0
		and tblOutput.IsCanceled = 0
		and tblOutput.OutputTypeID = 11
	Group by tblOutput.OutputOrderID

	----------- Main select - chi tiết theo dòng hàng hóa ---------------
	Select
		CRM_Partner.PartnerID,
		CRM_Partner.PartnerCode,
		CRM_Partner.PartnerName,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderID,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderCode,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderNo,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderDate,
		SMS_Item.ItemID,
		SMS_Item.ItemCode,
		SMS_Item.ItemName,
		isnull(tblOrderDetail.Quantity, 0) as Quantity,
		isnull(tblOrderDetail.OutputPrice, 0) as OutputPrice,
		isnull(tblOrderDetail.Money, 0) as ThanhTien,
		isnull(tblGiaTriHopDong.GiaTriHopDong, 0) as GiaTriHopDong,
		isnull(tblGiaTriDaThucHien.GiaTriDaThucHien, 0) as GiaTriDaThucHien,
		isnull(tblGiaTriHopDong.GiaTriHopDong, 0) - isnull(tblGiaTriDaThucHien.GiaTriDaThucHien, 0) as ConLai
	From #tblOrder tblOrder
		Inner join CRM_Partner on CRM_Partner.PartnerID = tblOrder.PartnerID
		Inner join SMS_OutputOrderDetail tblOrderDetail on tblOrderDetail.OutputOrderID = tblOrder.OutputOrderID
		Left join SMS_Item on SMS_Item.ItemID = tblOrderDetail.ItemID
		Left join #tblGiaTriHopDong tblGiaTriHopDong on tblGiaTriHopDong.OutputOrderID = tblOrder.OutputOrderID
		Left join #tblGiaTriDaThucHien tblGiaTriDaThucHien on tblGiaTriDaThucHien.OutputOrderID = tblOrder.OutputOrderID
	Order by CRM_Partner.OrderIndex,
		CRM_Partner.PartnerName,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderDate,
		tblOrder.OutputOrderCode,
		tblOrderDetail.OrderIndex

	Drop table #tblOrder
	Drop table #tblGiaTriHopDong
	Drop table #tblGiaTriDaThucHien

END
GO
